title: Rava bar Pappa
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Shabbat 66b](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.66b.5); Hyman reports that Yuchasin has Rava son of Rav Pappa, and [the Rif](https://www.sefaria.org/Rif_Shabbat.30a.6) reads Rafram bar Pappa.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Bavli names Rava bar Pappa. The Rif and [the Rosh](https://www.sefaria.org/Rosh_on_Shabbat.6.17.2) give Rafram bar Pappa. Hyman reports the reading in Yuchasin.
